pitch.description: Vertical staff line/space position directly determines diatonic note step.

accidental.description: Engraved sharp, flat, or natural glyphs printed before noteheads.

octave.description: Clef + staff line/space position + ottava brackets directly define octave register.

onset.description: Horizontal alignment and metric subdivision within measure sequence define onset.

duration.description: Notehead fill (black/white), stem, flags, beams, and augmentation dots directly define duration.

rest.description: Engraved rest glyphs (whole, half, quarter, eighth, etc.) directly define rest durations.

measure_sequence.description: Barlines and system reading order directly establish measure progression.

time_signature.description: Meter glyphs / numerals printed at score and section starts.

staff.description: Staff assignment (upper vs lower) is visually direct in ordinary notation, but conditionally ambiguous in cross-staff beaming.

tie.description: Curved tie arc between identical pitches is visually present, but conditionally ambiguous with phrasing slurs.

voice.description: MusicXML voice integer (voice=1, voice=2) is an invisible serialization label; only stem direction and beam groupings are printed.

tonal_global_confidence.rationale: Global Krumhansl-Kessler correlation over pitch-class duration distribution.

tonal_local_confidence_mean.rationale: Mean local key correlation across 8-measure sliding windows.

tonal_local_confidence_std.rationale: Standard deviation of local key correlations across windows.

tonal_center_change_rate.rationale: Frequency of estimated key changes per measure across sliding windows.

tonal_circle5_distance_mean.rationale: Mean fifths distance between successive key estimations.

tonal_circle5_distance_max.rationale: Maximum fifths distance between successive key estimations.

tonal_chromatic_duration_share.rationale: Fraction of sounding duration belonging to non-diatonic chromatic pitches.

tonal_mode_switch_rate.rationale: Frequency of major/minor mode transitions per measure.

sonority_pc_cardinality_mean.rationale: Mean number of distinct pitch classes sounding at unique attack onsets.

sonority_pc_cardinality_std.rationale: Standard deviation of pitch-class set cardinalities across attack onsets.

sonority_change_rate.rationale: Rate of pitch-class set transitions per measure.

sonority_stable_duration_share.rationale: Proportion of sounding duration occupied by stable harmonic sonorities.

sonority_ic1_semitone_share.rationale: Proportion of vertical interval dyads having interval class 1 (semitone/major seventh).

sonority_ic6_tritone_share.rationale: Proportion of vertical interval dyads having interval class 6 (tritone).

sonority_bass_interval_variety.rationale: Variety of interval classes formed above the lowest sounding pitch at each onset.

cadence_boundary_candidate_rate.rationale: Frequency of phrase boundary candidates identified by rest gaps or long durations.

cadence_boundary_strength_mean.rationale: Mean metric and harmonic strength score across phrase boundaries.

cadence_tonic_resolution_rate.rationale: Rate of cadential resolutions arriving on tonic harmony per measure.

cadence_dominant_tonic_proxy_rate.rationale: Rate of authentic V-I / dominant-tonic cadential motions per measure.

cadence_deceptive_proxy_rate.rationale: Rate of deceptive V-vi cadential motions per measure.

cadence_resolution_strength_mean.rationale: Mean harmonic resolution strength score across detected cadential events.

form_ssm_recurrence_density.rationale: Density of off-diagonal recurrence in Self-Similarity Matrix across measures.

form_novelty_peak_rate.rationale: Rate of structural novelty peaks along SSM checkerboard kernel per measure.

form_novelty_mean.rationale: Mean structural novelty score across piece timeline.

form_return_late_strength.rationale: Similarity score between exposition material and final third reprise.

form_recurrence_distance_mean.rationale: Mean distance in measures between recurring thematic segments.

form_ctu_first_occurrence_mean.rationale: Mean normalized timeline position where thematic CTU units first appear.

form_ctu_recurrence_dispersion.rationale: Dispersion of CTU unit recurrences throughout the score.

form_ctu_late_return_presence.rationale: Binary indicator of whether initial thematic CTU recurs in the final third.

vl_outer_parallel_motion_share.rationale: Proportion of outer-voice motions where soprano and bass move in parallel intervals.

vl_outer_contrary_motion_share.rationale: Proportion of outer-voice motions where soprano and bass move in contrary motion.

vl_outer_oblique_motion_share.rationale: Proportion of outer-voice motions where one voice sustains while the other moves.

vl_soprano_step_resolution_share.rationale: Proportion of highest-voice melodic motions that proceed stepwise (<= 2 semitones).

vl_bass_step_motion_share.rationale: Proportion of lowest-voice bass motions that proceed stepwise (<= 2 semitones).

vl_semitone_approach_rate.rationale: Frequency of semitone (leading tone / chromatic) melodic approaches per measure.

vl_common_tone_retention_rate.rationale: Frequency with which at least one pitch class is retained across consecutive onsets.

vl_min_voice_leading_distance_mean.rationale: Mean minimal voice-leading distance (Tymoczko optimal bipartite transport metric).

texture_register_centroid_mean.rationale: Mean MIDI pitch across all sounding note attacks.

texture_register_centroid_std.rationale: Standard deviation of measure-level registral pitch centroids.

texture_register_span_mean.rationale: Mean vertical pitch span (highest minus lowest pitch) at each sounding onset.

texture_register_span_max.rationale: Maximum vertical pitch span observed across the score.

texture_interstaff_gap_mean.rationale: Mean pitch clearance between staff 1 lowest note and staff 2 highest note (depends on staff assignment).

texture_simultaneity_attack_mean.rationale: Mean number of simultaneous note attacks per onset.

texture_block_chord_share.rationale: Proportion of onsets featuring 3 or more simultaneous note attacks.

texture_arpeggiation_proxy_rate.rationale: Rate of unidirectional arpeggiated runs exceeding one octave per measure.

texture_octave_doubling_share.rationale: Proportion of onsets containing octave-doubled pitch classes.

texture_repeated_note_attack_rate.rationale: Rate of rapid repeated note attacks on the exact same pitch per measure.

traj_register_center_slope.rationale: Linear slope of pitch registral centroid over piece timeline.

traj_register_span_slope.rationale: Linear slope of vertical register span over piece timeline.

traj_attack_density_slope.rationale: Linear slope of note attack density over piece timeline.

traj_attack_density_curvature.rationale: Quadratic curvature parameter of note attack density profile.

traj_chromaticity_slope.rationale: Linear slope of non-diatonic chromatic duration share over piece timeline.

traj_sonority_cardinality_slope.rationale: Linear slope of harmonic pitch-class cardinality over piece timeline.

traj_density_early_late_contrast.rationale: Contrast difference in attack density between first third and final third of piece.

traj_register_volatility.rationale: Standard deviation of pitch registral movements across windowed segments.

cadence_dominant_tonic_proxy_rate.rationale: Rate of authentic V-I / dominant-tonic cadential motions per measure.

cadence_deceptive_proxy_rate.rationale: Rate of deceptive V-vi cadential motions per measure.

cadence_resolution_strength_mean.rationale: Mean harmonic resolution strength score across detected cadential events.

form_ssm_recurrence_density.rationale: Density of off-diagonal recurrence in Self-Similarity Matrix across measures.

form_novelty_peak_rate.rationale: Rate of structural novelty peaks along SSM checkerboard kernel per measure.

form_novelty_mean.rationale: Mean structural novelty score across piece timeline.

form_return_late_strength.rationale: Similarity score between exposition material and final third reprise.

form_recurrence_distance_mean.rationale: Mean distance in measures between recurring thematic segments.

form_ctu_first_occurrence_mean.rationale: Mean normalized timeline position where thematic CTU units first appear.

form_ctu_recurrence_dispersion.rationale: Dispersion of CTU unit recurrences throughout the score.

form_ctu_late_return_presence.rationale: Binary indicator of whether initial thematic CTU recurs in the final third.

vl_outer_parallel_motion_share.rationale: Proportion of outer-voice motions where soprano and bass move in parallel intervals.

vl_outer_contrary_motion_share.rationale: Proportion of outer-voice motions where soprano and bass move in contrary motion.

vl_outer_oblique_motion_share.rationale: Proportion of outer-voice motions where one voice sustains while the other moves.

vl_soprano_step_resolution_share.rationale: Proportion of highest-voice melodic motions that proceed stepwise (<= 2 semitones).

vl_bass_step_motion_share.rationale: Proportion of lowest-voice bass motions that proceed stepwise (<= 2 semitones).

vl_semitone_approach_rate.rationale: Frequency of semitone (leading tone / chromatic) melodic approaches per measure.

vl_common_tone_retention_rate.rationale: Frequency with which at least one pitch class is retained across consecutive onsets.

vl_min_voice_leading_distance_mean.rationale: Mean minimal voice-leading distance (Tymoczko optimal bipartite transport metric).

texture_register_centroid_mean.rationale: Mean MIDI pitch across all sounding note attacks.

texture_register_centroid_std.rationale: Standard deviation of measure-level registral pitch centroids.

texture_register_span_mean.rationale: Mean vertical pitch span (highest minus lowest pitch) at each sounding onset.

texture_register_span_max.rationale: Maximum vertical pitch span observed across the score.

texture_interstaff_gap_mean.rationale: Mean pitch clearance between staff 1 lowest note and staff 2 highest note (depends on staff assignment).

texture_simultaneity_attack_mean.rationale: Mean number of simultaneous note attacks per onset.

texture_block_chord_share.rationale: Proportion of onsets featuring 3 or more simultaneous note attacks.

texture_arpeggiation_proxy_rate.rationale: Rate of unidirectional arpeggiated runs exceeding one octave per measure.

texture_octave_doubling_share.rationale: Proportion of onsets containing octave-doubled pitch classes.

texture_repeated_note_attack_rate.rationale: Rate of rapid repeated note attacks on the exact same pitch per measure.

traj_register_center_slope.rationale: Linear slope of pitch registral centroid over piece timeline.

traj_register_span_slope.rationale: Linear slope of vertical register span over piece timeline.

traj_attack_density_slope.rationale: Linear slope of note attack density over piece timeline.

traj_attack_density_curvature.rationale: Quadratic curvature parameter of note attack density profile.

traj_chromaticity_slope.rationale: Linear slope of non-diatonic chromatic duration share over piece timeline.

traj_sonority_cardinality_slope.rationale: Linear slope of harmonic pitch-class cardinality over piece timeline.

traj_density_early_late_contrast.rationale: Contrast difference in attack density between first third and final third of piece.

traj_register_volatility.rationale: Standard deviation of pitch registral movements across windowed segments.

pitch.description: Vertical staff line/space position directly determines diatonic note step.

accidental.description: Engraved sharp, flat, or natural glyphs printed before noteheads.

octave.description: Clef + staff line/space position + ottava brackets directly define octave register.

onset.description: Horizontal alignment and metric subdivision within measure sequence define onset.

duration.description: Notehead fill (black/white), stem, flags, beams, and augmentation dots directly define duration.

rest.description: Engraved rest glyphs (whole, half, quarter, eighth, etc.) directly define rest durations.

measure_sequence.description: Barlines and system reading order directly establish measure progression.

time_signature.description: Meter glyphs / numerals printed at score and section starts.

staff.description: Staff assignment (upper vs lower) is visually direct in ordinary notation, but conditionally ambiguous in cross-staff beaming.

tie.description: Curved tie arc between identical pitches is visually present, but conditionally ambiguous with phrasing slurs.

voice.description: MusicXML voice integer (voice=1, voice=2) is an invisible serialization label; only stem direction and beam groupings are printed.

tonal_global_confidence.rationale: Global Krumhansl-Kessler correlation over pitch-class duration distribution.

tonal_local_confidence_mean.rationale: Mean local key correlation across 8-measure sliding windows.

tonal_local_confidence_std.rationale: Standard deviation of local key correlations across windows.

tonal_center_change_rate.rationale: Frequency of estimated key changes per measure across sliding windows.

tonal_circle5_distance_mean.rationale: Mean fifths distance between successive key estimations.

tonal_circle5_distance_max.rationale: Maximum fifths distance between successive key estimations.

tonal_chromatic_duration_share.rationale: Fraction of sounding duration belonging to non-diatonic chromatic pitches.

tonal_mode_switch_rate.rationale: Frequency of major/minor mode transitions per measure.

sonority_pc_cardinality_mean.rationale: Mean number of distinct pitch classes sounding at unique attack onsets.

sonority_pc_cardinality_std.rationale: Standard deviation of pitch-class set cardinalities across attack onsets.

sonority_change_rate.rationale: Rate of pitch-class set transitions per measure.

sonority_stable_duration_share.rationale: Proportion of sounding duration occupied by stable harmonic sonorities.

sonority_ic1_semitone_share.rationale: Proportion of vertical interval dyads having interval class 1 (semitone/major seventh).

sonority_ic6_tritone_share.rationale: Proportion of vertical interval dyads having interval class 6 (tritone).

sonority_bass_interval_variety.rationale: Variety of interval classes formed above the lowest sounding pitch at each onset.
